verdict.rationale: Probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no markdown versions of the docs (HTTP 404), and no other evidence shows Aider publishes agent-oriented documentation. The /web command, which scrapes a page into markdown for the chat, is an adjacent feature for reading external docs, not agent-oriented docs about Aider itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
